Title: SL-01 Product grid shows all catalog items
Suite Description: The catalog grid, its layout toggle, and navigation into and back out of product details.
Description:
Product grid shows all catalog items.

Legacy ID: SL-01
Platforms: Android, iOS
Automated by: ProductGridTest.testProductGridDisplaysAllItems
Test data: standard_user / secret_sauce
Pre-conditions: Swag Labs app is installed and launched on the device
Step Action:
1. Log in with a valid user
2. Count the product cards rendered in the grid
3. Read the product name on every card
4. Read the price label on every card
5. Check that every card renders a product image
6. Check that every card exposes an ADD TO CART control

2. Exactly 6 product cards are displayed

4. Every price matches the format $X.XX
5. An image element is present and displayed on every card
6. An enabled ADD TO CART button is present on every card
